name: Aloo Keema
description: Pakistani aloo keema with beef mince and tender potatoes cooked in a concentrated tomato masala with green chillies and everyday spices.
ingredients: 3 medium potatoes, peeled and cut into even cubes
Salt to taste and fresh coriander for finishing
method: Heat the oil, add cumin seeds and cook the onion until softened and lightly golden.
Add the ginger-garlic paste and beef mince. Break the mince apart thoroughly and cook until it changes colour and much of its released moisture evaporates.
Add the tomatoes, green chillies, coriander powder, red chilli, turmeric and salt. Cook until the tomatoes soften and the masala becomes cohesive.
Add the potato cubes with only enough water to help them cook, cover and simmer gently until the potatoes are tender and the beef is fully cooked.
Remove the lid and reduce any excess liquid while stirring gently so the potatoes keep their shape and the keema remains moist rather than dry.
Finish with garam masala and fresh coriander, taste for salt and serve hot with roti or naan.
